tuto_1:
Put your gear on by accessing your inventory.
 Press the top button or the 0num key on the keyboard
tuto_sector:
1. ◈ Telemetry: Click a system to inspect celestial telemetry.
2. ▷ Trajectory: Click again to plot the hyper-jump vector.
3. ⚡ Navigation: FTL Warp jump requires 500 fuel units and a warp drive.
4. ❖ System: Switch to detailed system view using the controls below.
tuto_system:
1. ◈ Navigation: Click a celestial body to analyze its composition.
2. ▷ Propulsion: Click again to engage orbital approach vector.
3. ❖ Velocity: Hold Shift to activate high-output hyperdrive.
4. ⚓ Landing: Reach orbit to access surface landing sites and POIs.
tuto_subsystem:
◈ LANDING & SUBCOM COMMUNICATIONS
Leave the cockpit console to reach a docked or surface destination.
For remote inquiries or negotiations, initiate contact via Subcom.
